in_marathi.name: Devkinandan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Kin, Belonging to God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devkinandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devki (Goddess Durga) + Nandana (Giver of Pleasure). This name is derived from the Devi Mahatmya, where Goddess Durga is described as the giver of happiness and pleasure to her devotees. Thus, the name Devkinandan means 'God's Kin, Belonging to God'.
